_comment: SAMPLE, not a log entry. Kept out of entries/ so it never reaches stats or LOG.md. Shows the plan/update half of the sheet: on-deck meal cards, the `at` time chip, `ing` ingredient lines, and per-item `eaten` flags. Flip statuses and re-render to see all three sheet types.
